import copy

from packaging.specifiers import Specifier, SpecifierSet


def test_explicit_equivalence_and_changed_filter():
    versions = ["1.1a1", "1.1"]
    original = SpecifierSet([Specifier(">=1", prereleases=False)])
    equivalent_members = [Specifier(">=1.0", prereleases=False)]
    changed_members = [Specifier(">=1", prereleases=True)]

    # Observe both replacements before the assertion, including on negatives.
    equivalent = copy.replace(original, specifiers=equivalent_members)
    changed = copy.replace(original, specifiers=changed_members)
    actual = (equivalent is original, list(changed.filter(versions)))
    expected = (True, list(SpecifierSet(changed_members).filter(versions)))

    # Existing-constructor and preservation controls use public operations only.
    assert expected[1] == versions
    assert list(original.filter(versions)) == ["1.1"]
    assert type(equivalent) is type(original) is type(changed)
    assert actual == expected
single_relation.explanation: Both copy.replace calls execute before the combined assertion. Explicit same-policy canonical-equivalent supplied members must reuse original; changed element policy must match the existing public constructor plus mixed prerelease/final filter. Public constructor-output, original-preservation and exact runtime-type controls run in the same node. No private implementation field is read by the test.
